interface.name: polly_session_status_v1
interface.description: Only the trusted Shell and the separately spawned input-method connection may bind this global. The Shell may query status, but cannot mark a service ready. Only the current input-method connection may report initialization. Version 2 lets only the current ordinary-user Shell drain its compositor's public toplevels before ending its own session. It grants no arbitrary process, user, session ID, lock or keyboard control. Status reports startup completion, not hardware input or rendering quality.

entry.name: starting
entry.summary: process exists but initialization is incomplete

entry.name: ready
entry.summary: trusted engine initialized and input-method role is live

entry.name: failed
entry.summary: requested service exited, disconnected or lost its ready role

request.name: inspect
request.description: Only the currently trusted Shell connection may inspect. Exactly one status event echoes the serial. Clients must not cache this as authority after a later service loss.

request.name: input_method_initialized
request.description: Only the separately authorized input method may send this after engine setup, schema selection, state initialization and protocol synchronization. A live input-method object and keyboard grab are required. Loss of that object invalidates readiness. Other connections are rejected.

request.name: session_exit
request.description: Begin requests normal close from public toplevels, including registered unmapped ones. Inspect counts their actual resource lifetimes, not just visibility. Applications may retain their windows to save or cancel. Cancel never reopens an application or kills a process. Seal succeeds only after all public toplevel resources are gone; new toplevels are refused until cancellation or session exit. A denied operation has no closing side effects. The input method cannot use these requests.

event.name: session_exit_window

description.summary: bounded labels for pending public windows

event.description: Up to 256 labels precede the authoritative status count. Only public toplevels are included, never Shell UI or private service surfaces.

event.name: logout_requested

description.summary: show confirmation, not an exit grant

event.description: The compositor logout shortcut asks its trusted Shell to display the same confirmation flow as its user menu. No application is closed here.

request.name: watch_background

description.summary: observe an owned background's actual scene visibility

request.description: Only the current trusted Shell may watch its own background-layer surface. Updates reflect enabled output intersection and scene opaque occlusion, including session-lock coverage. Translucent foreground surfaces do not count as opaque coverage. This grants no pixels, focus, input, lock control or authority over other clients. At most 64 watches may exist per connection.

request.name: watch_overlay

description.summary: observe an owned non-focus-stealing desktop overlay

request.description: Only the current trusted Shell may observe its own mapped top/overlay layer with keyboard interactivity none and exclusive zone -1. Uses the same bounded watch pool and activity states as watch_background. This does not grant input, focus, foreign pixels or session-lock control.

interface.name: polly_background_activity_v1
interface.description: An initial state is followed only by changes. Inactive surfaces may become active again; retired targets never do. Destroying the watch releases its listeners, not the surface.
